extraction_notes: Family datasheet covering BZT52C2V0 through BZT52C75; the BZT52C3V9 row (marking code W5) was used for all part-specific table values.
Zener impedance for variant-Z fitting (no dedicated schema field): ZZT = 90 ohm maximum at IZT = 0.005 A; ZZK = 600 ohm maximum at IZK = 0.001 A (p. 2 Electrical Characteristics, BZT52C3V9 row).
Typical temperature coefficient at IZTC: -3.5 to 0 mV/degC; admissible zener current IZM listed as 5 mA in the table (p. 2).

Maximum ratings (p. 1): PD = 350 mW, RthJA = 357 degC/W, Tj and Tstg -55 to +150 degC. Note the p. 3 curve figures are annotated PD = 500 mW, inconsistent with the 350 mW rating on p. 1; curves were not relied on for limits.

Fig.1 Zener Characteristics (p. 3): the traces between the labeled 2.4 V and 4.7 V curves form an unlabeled cluster of six crossing curves (2.7, 3.0, 3.3, 3.6, 3.9, 4.3 V by inference); the 3.9 V trace cannot be attributed without guessing, so no I-V curve was digitized.
Capacitance is a single digitized read of the 0 V bias family typical-capacitance curve at nominal VZ = 3.9 V (approximately 180 pF); it is not a swept characteristic of this part.
Forward voltage is a single maximum limit (0.9 V at 10 mA) from the ratings table; the datasheet provides no forward I-V curve, so only one VF point is available.
omission_reason: Part-specific curves omitted: the Fig.1 zener I-V traces between 2.4 V and 4.7 V are unlabeled and mutually crossing, so the BZT52C3V9 trace cannot be identified unambiguously, and the remaining figures (temperature coefficient, leakage, capacitance, impedance) plot family-level quantities versus nominal zener voltage rather than operating characteristics of this part. Extraction therefore relies on the electrical characteristics table, supporting F1 fidelity only.
